text: Support. It extends a rule content already follows: beat_hesitate.json requires the child's reluctance to be shown physically, never named; today the companion often talks the tension away on the same page. A text-only form works now (a short 'mirror' line: the companion stops too, then relaxes when the child acts), and keeps the resolution the child's. Watch body assumptions (the roster includes a robot, per beat_meet_companion.json) and companion-name + 'da/de' harmony. The illustration-brief half waits for illustrated stories.
